# DARK TARGETS — the compile-fail allowlist, and it is a RATCHET, not a parking lot.
#
# A target listed here does not compile at HEAD. That means every #[test] in it is a
# falsifier that CANNOT FIRE, which is indistinguishable from a falsifier that always
# passes. `.github/workflows/ci.yml`'s `clippy-correctness` job FAILS if a target goes
# dark and is not on this list, and FAILS if a row here compiles again (delete it).
#
# Format: one row per target, exactly as `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets
# --keep-going --message-format=short` names it, minus the trailing error count:
#
#     <package> (<kind>[ "<name>"])
#
# ⚠ REPRODUCING LOCALLY REQUIRES `--keep-going`. A plain `cargo clippy --all-targets`
# ABORTS at the first non-compiling target and shows you nothing past it — which is the
# whole reason twelve of these accumulated unseen through 2026-07-25.
#
# Adding a row is a real cost. Say WHY, and name what the dark test was guarding.

# ── THE FRI SOUNDNESS LEDGER GATE (2 targets) ────────────────────────────────────────
# Both import `dregg_lean_ffi::{FriKnobs, FriLedger, fri_ledger, fri_ledger_available}`,
# which has ZERO definition sites tree-wide. The Rust binding was removed in TWO stages
# by TWO commits, neither of which mentions FRI:
#   * 7ebe7b7d4b (2026-07-20 05:08, "no-silent-fallback: two gates make unaudited PQ
#     substitution IMPOSSIBLE") rewrote `dregg-lean-ffi/build.rs` and dropped the
#     `dregg_fri_ledger` archive probe, its `rustc-check-cfg` declaration and its
#     `rustc-cfg` emission — so `dregg_fri_ledger_present` stopped being set.
#   * 0f2802a0ca (2026-07-20 21:53, "ML-KEM keygen now dispatches the VERIFIED core")
#     deleted the public API (`FriKnobs`/`FriLedger`/`fri_ledger`/`fri_ledger_available`
#     and the `mod ffi` bridge) plus `lean_init.c`'s `dregg_fri_ledger_str` C shim.
# The LEAN side is alive and orphaned: `@[export] dregg_fri_ledger`
# (metatheory/Dregg2/Circuit/FriLedger.lean:380) is inside the FFI boundary closure
# (metatheory/Dregg2/FFI.lean:31), so the symbol IS in today's archive.
#
# WHAT IS DARK: the knob-drift PIN — the sole guard that the deployed FRI knobs still
# equal the Lean literals every per-fold soundness theorem is stated about — plus the
# per-config ledger floors and six mutation canaries. Cited as load-bearing in 16 files
# under docs/ and GOAL-*.md. Verified by hand 2026-07-25: no knob has drifted while the
# gate was dark (all 7 shipped configs still match their Lean literals) — but that is a
# manual reading with a shelf life, not a gate.
#
# REPAIR (restores both rows at once) is confined to `dregg-lean-ffi/`, which was a live
# lane's territory on 2026-07-25; restore from 0f2802a0ca^ / 7ebe7b7d4b^:
#   1. src/lib.rs           — FriKnobs, FriLedger, fri_ledger_available, fri_ledger, and
#                             mod ffi's extern decl + lean_fri_ledger + fri_ledger_present
#                             (both cfg arms, and the not(lean) stub).
#   2. src/lean_init.c      — `extern lean_object *dregg_fri_ledger(lean_object*);` and the
#                             `dregg_fri_ledger_str` string bridge.
#   3. build.rs             — `archive_exports(&build_archive, "dregg_fri_ledger")`, the
#                             `cargo::rustc-check-cfg=cfg(dregg_fri_ledger_present)` and the
#                             `cargo:rustc-cfg=dregg_fri_ledger_present` emission.
# OWNER: the dregg-lean-ffi / FRI lane.
dregg-circuit-prove (test "fri_params_soundness_budget")
dregg-circuit-prove (test "fri_regrid_post_s2_measure")
